description: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult are public structs in jmap-mail-server's public API. Neither carries #[non_exhaustive]. Adding a field (e.g. a 'warnings' field) to either struct is a semver-breaking change: callers using struct-literal construction will fail to compile. Both structs are return types from MdnBackend trait methods, so every backend implementation would break on a field addition. The Mdn, MdnSendRequest, MdnParseRequest etc. in jmap-mail-types all carry #[non_exhaustive] — MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult should too. Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to both.
title: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult missing #[non_exhaustive]
